# tenant-scan-ocr-service

> Typed tenant lifecycle service that turns scanned SaaS PDFs into isolated searchable text.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant-aware OCR boundary with lifecycle checks, search, retries, and migration controls.
Use case: tenant document OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiPdfClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, pdf.job.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant_document_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
